summary: No source unit for AT-workflows-10/11 can currently advance R0.02 without either duplicating the existing route/skill diagnostic cases or inventing a workflow commitment, wake, dossier, primary-citation, or authenticated-runtime owner. Keep both assigned ATs pending and revisit after their real consumers exist.

assignedAcceptances.requiredBehavior: A research commitment dispatches through toy_delegate with requested and observed Sol/medium/Fast, supported ModelRoute, the loaded upstream skill revision/text digest, question, artifacts and primary citations recorded; ordinary delegation retains its canonical route.

Luna/max, missing skill, unverified tier mapping or paid fallback blocks research acceptance with its exact gap; the research commitment/wake survives, no paid route executes, and no fabricated skill/receipt is recorded.

workflowSpec.implementationDetail: §6.2 at line 311 requires toy_delegate role=research, candidate_write, the research commitment UUID and focused question; records supported route, skill source revision/SHA-256, loaded digest, citations and artifact import/readback; it says the provider tier mapping is verified at R0, not guessed.

ownerPath.fact: An unfiltered registered Hermes delegation.route-skill probe dispatches to ModelRouteProbe.

The current probe invokes a fixed external Codex executor, exercises route/skill failures and result-file integrity, and persists diagnostic checks through the public probe owner. Its research fixture is synthetic markdown with an example.invalid citation.

ModelRoute.delegationReceipt resolves the pinned skill and requested role route, verifies the observed route, and returns bounded artifact metadata. It only admits a ready R0 test world with fake clock and fake model; receipts hard-code nativeExecutionVerified:false and acceptanceComplete:false.

The current input carries requestId, purpose and objective; its task is limited to scope r0-feasibility/depth 1. The receipt carries hashes and artifact references, not a commitment UUID, candidate_write mode, accepted dossier, or citation records.

relatedAssignedAcceptance.relationship: Its bounded toy_delegate research launch assertion overlaps the same route/skill/artifact owner family. It is not evidence for AT-workflows-10/11 and is not a reason to add duplicate route cases here.

registeredOwnerEvidence.measured: The unfiltered CLI run/show has exact registration and 9/9 diagnostic checks. It binds requested/observed research route, skill commit/content/loaded digests, route-mismatch and skill-missing refusal, and the separate ordinary route. The positive fixture is explicitly fixtureOnly; liveProviderSends=0, nativeExecutionVerified=false, acceptanceComplete=false, wholeATComplete=false. It is a component research receipt gate, not AT-workflows-10/11.

Its existing delegation.route-skill case set includes route observed/missing/Luna/wrong effort/wrong tier, missing/wrong skill bytes, ordinary implementation Luna, and module-local override refusal. Its successful route receipt is a fake external CLI fixture and keeps nativeExecutionVerified=false and acceptanceComplete=false. These cases overlap the route/skill portion of AT-workflows-10/11 and are not their acceptance results.

baseline.reason: tests/registry.yaml has no AT-workflows-10 or AT-workflows-11 source-bound manifest; the TEST-PLAN names the probe IDs but no matching CLI case registration exists. The saved AT-workflows-1/2 generic NOT_IMPLEMENTED baseline is not a baseline for these IDs.

stillUnproved: An actual toy_delegate dispatch bound to a durable research commitment UUID and candidate_write workspace.
An authenticated supported ModelRoute run and externally verified Fast-to-provider-tier mapping.
Question, real primary citations, and imported artifacts as acceptance-readable records; current fixture records an objective/task digest and artifact digest but its citation is example.invalid.
Dossier admission denial with exact accepted-research gap and a persisted no-acceptance result.
Durable commitment/wake survival across refusal, which requires the R1 obligation transaction/consumer rather than a fabricated fixture state.
No actual paid route execution under an authenticated owner, and no fabricated receipt in the accepted dossier store.

sourceDecision.reason: A new manifest using the existing nine route/skill cases would repeat current ModelRoute coverage and still leave the workflow-specific acceptance untested. The adjacent AT-hermes-config-42 bounded research-launch AT is also pending and shares this owner family. The distinct missing state belongs to the not-yet-present durable commitment/wake and dossier path or needs the actual account-backed route required by the assignment. Do not add a placeholder consumer or fixture receipt.

requiredConsumersIfRevisited.interfaceRequirement: Consume a real research commitment UUID and candidate_write question/workspace; call ModelRoute with verified route/skill; import/read back the result artifact and primary citations.
Durably preserve the open commitment and current research wake when admission refuses; use the written capture/due/transaction owner rather than probe-local state.
Accept only a current-generation, independently evidenced research result and expose its denial reason while leaving the obligation open.

deferredFacts: The AT-workflows-10/11 required account-backed route and exact Fast tier mapping remain unmeasured; fake executor observations are not substitutes.
The real upstream research skill load/receipt and primary-citation provenance in the protected runtime remain unproved.
Durable commitment/wake preservation and accepted-dossier state remain unproved because those consumers are R1 scope and absent from the current source owner.
Both assigned ATs and the full R0.02 card remain pending; this plan grants no acceptance credit.
